construct: align-self: start on a fixed-size grid child, with no justify-self declared
why: grid-child-align already measures justify-self, and the table's align-self row cites that case's SIBLING channel — its engine anchor literally names 'justify-self'. Measuring the cross-axis alone, with the main axis left at its default, is what distinguishes 'both anchors are carried' from 'one anchor is carried and the other rides along'.

canvas.note: gridChildVerticalAlign MIN on the child, its horizontal anchor left AUTO
